Name: Gothic Cursors
Author: FaerieFangs0
Description:
Have you ever thought "Hey, this game needs some morbid but still kinda cute little cursors?" If yes, welcome. If you're thinking "No, and also why would you?" I don't know how you got here, but you're still welcome. There's not much to say other than it's a gothic themed little cursor pack.

It looks kind of nice in my opinion with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35996]DBB's Victorian Gothic Interface[/url], but use it with whatever you prefer. I'm not your dad.

The only requirements are the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and it's dependencies.

Just drag and drop into your mod folder to install.

Manifest.Name: Gothic Cursors
Manifest.Description: Changes your cursor to be gothic themed.
